source: the regex-timeout replay walks XGrapheme (\X), GraphemeBound (\b{g}, reading Matcher.last) and NFCCharProperty (classes under an inline (?c)), as Curly atoms when quantified alone, so RegexStringMatcher (DOTALL | CASE_INSENSITIVE | UNICODE_CASE, matches()) passes regexMatchingTimeoutMillis (here 300) on a 40-character value where the oracle's JVM does and logs its WARN, and stays within it where the JVM does

steps.note: XGrapheme in a Curly inside the {25} loop explodes as .* does
an inline (?c) makes [a-z] an NFCCharProperty, a Curly atom: the loop still explodes
\b{g} holds between the a's (Matcher.last stays 0), so the loop explodes as without it
the look-ahead's accept leaves Matcher.last after the first a, so \b{g} fails there at once: no timeout
nine \X* are Curly nodes without Loop.posIndex: polynomial past the budget
